Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, If you work with international customers, your invoice-to-cash process likely has some friction—slow payments, high fees, or manual steps that slow cash flow.
You’re not alone. 55% of finance leaders say they lose 4–5% in revenue each month because of it.
Flywire helps simplify the process—from invoicing to payment to reconciliation—across 240 countries and 140 currencies.
We put together a quick cost-savings analysis <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-much-does-it-cost-you-to-get-paid?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>. Spoiler: one company saved over $1M a year.
Want to see what it could look like for your team?
Best, Hope Kim
